usage: CCH_SOURCE_DSN=... CCH_TARGET_DSN=... bun scripts/sync-cch-config.ts [--rules rules.json] [--policy policy.json] [--overwrite] [--dry-run] [--lang zh-CN|zh-TW|en|ja|ru]
preview: Preview: no target writes. Each table shows source rows and current target rows.
restart: Restart the target CCH to refresh provider, endpoint, and model price caches.
invalid_rules: Invalid rules. See the configuration sync documentation.
invalid_policy: Invalid policy: preserveProviders must be an array of provider names and rules an array of rules.
missing_preserved_provider: A whitelisted target provider is missing. Sync refused; check its name and soft-deletion status.
invalid_field: A rule uses an unknown, protected, or unsupported field.
invalid_host: The replacement host must be hostname[:port], without scheme, path, or credentials.
schema_mismatch: Source and target configuration columns or types differ. Align database migrations first.
same_database: Source and target are the same database. Sync refused.
missing_vendor: Configuration references a missing vendor. Transaction rolled back.
failed: Sync failed; target transaction was not committed. Check connections, permissions, rule values, and database constraints.
